## #1 — capnchunky — 2007-03-12
<https://www.cheetah3d.com/forum/index.php?threads/1421/post-8966>

Numeric Transform

Download (3kb) -- Put it in the Tool folder in the scripts folder.

Improved for version 4.0 -- Numeric Transform will now automatically use whatever the document's current selection mode is: point, edge, or polygon.  For those of you still using 3.x: the script will still work, you just have to manually tell it which mode to use.

I also moved the actions from a menu to their own separate buttons, mainly because I got tired of having to pull the menu down every time I use the script.

--

This is one that had been on my wishlist.  This script takes a point, edge, or polygon selection and lets you perform transformations numerically, such as rotating by 30 degrees or scaling by 2.  It will also allow you to get and set the position of the selection by its centerpoint.

As always, please let me know if you have any suggestions or improvements.

Attachments: [numeric_transform.png](https://www.cheetah3d.com/forum/index.php?attachments/1864/)

Links: http://www.users.muohio.edu/howellme/cheetah3d/Numeric_Transform.js.zip
